    right="Feat 5"

>
[Stretching Reach](/Feats.aspx?ID=5374) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 44

</column>

---

You can leverage your size and muscle to extend your reach and attack more distant foes. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.
name: Stretching Reach
